about.developer_label: Built with love and care from
about.fun_fact_content: This game was built using React and Tailwind CSS
about.p1: We believe games should be technically excellent and easily accessible. That’s why all games are currently free of charge, and we ensure the experience is seamless and enjoyable for everyone — without complicated login processes, registration forms, or additional downloads.
about.p2: Multiplayer or Local Play: Play with friends or family on the same screen, or enjoy smooth remote sessions.
about.p3: Free Now: Everything is free in the beta version. We want you to try and enjoy it first.
about.p5: If you're curious about what happens behind the scenes, we share our journey in building this platform — how we combine high performance, efficiency, and innovative technologies like state management, caching, and real-time multiplayer gameplay. All of this ensures a smooth, scalable experience while leveraging deep technical learning and experimentation.

game-setup-description: Choose a logo set and grid size, enter player names, then start guessing! Players take turns asking questions and eliminating logos.
player-input-max-error: Name must be at most 20 characters

instructions.step1: 1. Each player mentally selects one logo from their grid
instructions.step2: 2. Players take turns asking yes/no questions verbally
instructions.step3: 3. Click on logos to eliminate them based on the answers
instructions.step4: 4. First player to correctly guess their opponent's logo wins!

instructions.rule1: When it's your turn, you have exactly 5 seconds to say 3 things that match the category shown on screen.
instructions.rule2: Speak your answers out loud - don't type them! Think fast and say the first things that come to mind.
instructions.rule3: After time's up, other players vote whether your answers were valid. Get majority votes to earn 1 point and build your streak.
instructions.rule4: Build a streak of 3 correct answers to earn a random Power-Up! Use them strategically to help yourself or sabotage others.
instructions.rule5: The player with the most points at the end wins. Remember: it's about quick thinking, laughter, and friendly chaos!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Game Hub respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and all other applicable laws. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform. At present, there is no user authentication; accordingly, we do not collect account-related data such as email addresses or passwords.
privacy.p2:
We automatically collect the following categories of information through analytics tools when you interact with the platform:

• **Usage Data**: URL paths, entry/exit points, page titles, queries, sources, referrers, channels, domains, hostnames, tags, and events (e.g., starting or completing game sessions).

• **Device and Browser Data**: Browser type, operating system (OS), device type, language, screen resolution, and environment.

• **Location Data**: Approximate location derived from your IP address, including country, region, and city.

• **Other Data**: Any names or identifiers included in URLs (e.g., player names in game links such as /en/guess-logo/game/.../Haider/Yousef), which may reveal personal names if voluntarily provided by users.

We do not collect sensitive personal data unless it is voluntarily submitted within game content. If payments are made, third-party payment service providers process financial details; we do not store payment information.
privacy.p3:
• To operate and improve the platform (e.g., analytics to understand user behavior and enhance games).
• To deliver features such as online multiplayer and session tracking.
• For marketing and advertising (e.g., targeted ads based on location or usage).
• To comply with legal obligations and prevent fraud.
privacy.p4:
We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with:

• Service providers (e.g., analytics tools, hosting services) under strict confidentiality obligations.
• Law enforcement or regulatory authorities when required by Saudi law.
• In the event of a business transfer (e.g., merger or acquisition).
privacy.p5: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your data, including encryption where appropriate. However, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.p6: Under the PDPL, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, or restrict the processing of your personal data. Since there is no authentication, please contact us with details of your interaction (e.g., IP address or URL) to exercise these rights. You may opt out of analytics by disabling cookies or adjusting browser settings.
privacy.p7: We use cookies and similar technologies for analytics purposes. You may manage these through your browser settings.
privacy.p8: The platform is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy.p9: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted here with the updated date.
